variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Well, well! A stranger in Brackenford, or should I say a hero, lad! Heh, heh, heh...

Those Urchins are most troublesome. I can't deny it any longer -- they crept into my mill last night and made off with my amulet.

I think I know which ones did it. If that's all they took, then we are lucky the millstones are too heavy for them.

Quickly! The old barrow is east of the ford! Will you go and bring my amulet back?

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: My amulet! Here, take these potions. You must keep them close at hand in a fight. If you wait too long before you drink one, it will do you no good! Once your wounds are mended, you may go after more thieves, or carry on with your travels.

journal.text: Go to the old barrow and recover Wenna's amulet.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Halvard, here is another traveller who wishes to try his luck with Red Corwin's bandits!

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: It's a bit quiet today, with the north gate shut and all.

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: Shouldn't you be off chasing bandits?

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: Welcome to Brackenford. The Chapel of the Ford is down by the river.

variants.specifics: Kal Vorra: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Pellam
offer.text:
Spiders? Sure, I know all about 'em. Ate my best mule.

Follow the west tunnel, out past the ore carts, over the rope bridge. That's where they nest. Clear 'em out and there's gold in it for you.

completion.speaker: Pellam
completion.text: Thanks for your help! Here's 100 gold. Now I just have to go buy myself a new mule!

journal.text: Clear the Spiders out of the west tunnel for Pellam the mule keeper.

guard.speaker: Torg
guard.text: Only working miners may ride the lift!

shop.speaker: Ilva
shop.text: This is Scrolls-Galore. I doubt you'll find a thing worth buying here, stranger.

variants.specifics: Velk: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Orvane
offer.text:
Welcome to Velk, Home of the Marsh Folk. You shall be my new helper.

It is all settled. You may take any path you like, but do not linger too long.

The Imps who took my enchanted cloak live in the Hollow Stump. Just cross the Long Walk east and you will find the Stump. Will you bring my cloak back?

completion.speaker: Orvane
completion.text: Hang my cloak on the hook by the stove. Then take the Spell Book which sits on the shelf above my bed. You will find all sorts of spells inside. Try them out on the Leeches.

guard.speaker: Brask
guard.text:
I would take it up with Mayor Quillon...
unless you want to rile him.

shop.speaker: Grudd
shop.text: Haven't had many travelers lately. Velk isn't exactly a pleasure trip these days, what with the dead climbing up the stilts at night.

variants.specifics: Castle Tarbek: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Hello, I am Fennick, the Master of Hounds for Castle Tarbek.

What might a traveler be doing so far from the high road? Hmm, let me guess... Ostrik has sent you to help Commander Brask with some garrison business.

Well, I've no great love for Brask and his endless marching drills, but let me put you to better use, stranger.

The Black Bears of the Thornwood, west of the castle, keep killing my hounds. Drive them off and I'll see you rewarded. Take this bow. It might help when they charge.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text:
Marvelous! Tarbek owes you a debt it can never repay.

But no time to fuss over my poor hounds now! Morvane's dead men are stirring! Take this quiver and go after them, if you want to see an end to his wicked doings!

journal.text: Battle your way through the Thornwood and drive off the Black Bears for Fennick.

guard.speaker: Brogan
guard.text:
Hold it right there, stranger! Commander Brask has shut the East Gate to all travelers and Morvane's Undead on the east road are reason enough for it.

Back you go! I've got a cold and lonely post to keep here.

Will you move along quietly, stranger?

shop.speaker: Thudd
shop.text:
Wanna see a new blade?

I call it 'Morvane's Misery.'

townsfolk1.speaker: Tibbet
townsfolk1.text: Hello there! My name is Tibbet. I catch and cage the castle rats to keep the granary safe for the garrison.

townsfolk2.speaker: Bessa
townsfolk2.text: I'm late for my shift in the kitchens, sorry.

variants.specifics: Kelm: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gisla
offer.text:
I've never set foot in the reed caves and can only repeat you the warning my husband gave me, long ago -- mind the deep water.

The Imps who live there stole my magic lantern off the dock. Will you bring it back to me?

completion.speaker: Gisla
completion.text:
Wonderful! Thank you kindly, young sir. I am truly amazed at your courage!

Now, you must take these Leather Boots.

journal.text: Find a way to win back Gisla's lantern from the Imps.

guard.speaker: Torvik
guard.text: You look handy enough. But that won't get you through this gate! Now move along!

shop.speaker: Odra
shop.text: Strangers aren't trusted here. But for a few coins more, I'll trust you just this once.

townsfolk1.speaker: Brannoc
townsfolk1.text: I've heard that Vaskor the Necromancer has at last grown tired of hiding out on his island. He's raising the drowned for an attack on Kelm! We must all keep a sharp eye on the shore!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Friend, bless you for stopping to help me... But you're late, I'm afraid. My leg is broken. I can't stand...

But hear me... I chased the Bats down into the old cistern under the orchard...

But the cistern is home to something far worse -- swarms of Wisps! I saw them over the water, obeying a man's voice.

He was laughing... Drive them out, friend, and my purse is yours.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text:
Ah, there you are! Healer Mossa says I'll walk again! Good work! Never thought you'd come up out of there! heh, heh, heh.

But here now, take your 100 gold and hurry on to the Star Tower where that wicked Vaskar hides!

journal.text:
Drive the Wisps from the cistern in order to help Fennick.

The way in is most likely through the old orchard well.

guard.speaker: Tobb
guard.text: Through the gate, stranger! Mind your manners!

shop.speaker: Margle
shop.text: You look as though you need a good night's rest, stranger.

townsfolk1.speaker: Kester
townsfolk1.text: That traitor Vaskar has left the College half empty. Stop those Imps of his before they burn the library.

townsfolk2.speaker: Gussa
townsfolk2.text: Wonderful news! I hear my son passed his Fireball exam!

variants.specifics: Fort Vestrin: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Grunda
offer.text: My old legs go no farther than this, lad. The Urchins dragged my Bearskin Cloak off to their cave -- just under the west wall. Will you bring it back to me?

completion.speaker: Grunda
completion.text: I said 'hand it here'! Now take this gold before the fire burns low with my generosity.

journal.text: Recover Grunda's cloak from the Urchin cave.

guard.speaker: Hulgar
guard.text: Shouldn't you be out on the pass smashing skeletons?

shop.speaker: Torgal
shop.text: The snow has closed the road down to the lowlands.

townsfolk1.speaker: Dagna
townsfolk1.text: Quartermaster Ulfa has locked herself in the pantry until someone rids the cellar of rats. I hope someone has gone to fetch Gorrin. He usually just traps the rats instead of stomping them.

townsfolk2.speaker: Fitch
townsfolk2.text: I'd swear I saw a skeleton up on the wall just now. It actually waved!

variants.specifics: Ostrak: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Yorga
offer.text:
So you're the one Gavrik sent! Wonderful! The Bats roost up the slag road to your left, in the big cave past the cooling pools. I've opened the Slag Gate for you. I'll make it worth your while.

Welcome to Ostrak!

completion.speaker: Yorga
completion.text: Ah, here they are... some of the finest potions in Ostrak. My sister Quilla mixed them for the stokers, in case the furnaces ever blew. They should serve you well against the fires you'll surely meet up on Mount Krell.

guard.speaker: Brugo
guard.text: I'm under orders not to chat with outsiders.

shop.speaker: Quilla
shop.text: Sorry, stranger, but my shelves are looking bare. Hard times make people stock up on potions. Heh, heh, heh...

townsfolk1.speaker: Magra
townsfolk1.text: Well you sure don't look like much. I'd hate to have you minding my forge.

townsfolk2.speaker: Toller
townsfolk2.text: Well there goes the furnace again. Can't forge, guess I'll go take a nap.

variants.specifics: Tarrow Crossing: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Marga
offer.text: Search the old windmill from top to bottom if you have to. If you want a torch or a rope, you can take the ones hanging by my door. The windmill is just up the west road. Will you bring my amulet back from those Imps?

completion.speaker: Marga
completion.text: Wonderful, my amulet. Here, have a couple of these.

journal.text: Fight your way into the old windmill and recover Marga's amulet from the Imps.

guard.speaker: Thurl
guard.text: Hurry! Mayor Pellam is waiting for you upstairs in the Town Hall. There's a ladder behind the clerk's desk that will take you right up to him.

shop.speaker: Bodrick
shop.text: I hear Gorbash's Ogres are coming down out of the hills. Might be time for me to sell the Copper Kettle and move on.

townsfolk1.speaker: Fenna
townsfolk1.text: Hello young sir! Come find me after you've beaten the Ogres.

townsfolk2.speaker: Jory
townsfolk2.text: Don't give up hope now, stranger, those Ogres will run from our pitchforks!

variants.specifics: Tullin: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Barlo
offer.text:
Fear not, I have this whole business well in hand. I shall meet those Ogres wherever they dare to come down, it makes no difference to me.

But first there is a nest of wasps in the old orchard which none of my men will go near.

Once you burn it out, the Ogres shall learn the true might of the Tullin Watch! I'll pay you 80 gold for it.

completion.speaker: Barlo
completion.text: Wasp stings will swell up something awful, but this potion will help with that. Here's your 80 gold.

guard.speaker: Hessa
guard.text: Well, well! You sure look tougher than the last few heroes! Come find me at the gate once you're done chasing off Ogres.

shop.speaker: Dorrick
shop.text: You don't belong back here. You need to go round to the front of the forge.

townsfolk1.speaker: Fennick
townsfolk1.text: They say you're the one who drove the Imps out of the old well! Thank you, stranger!

townsfolk2.speaker: Joss
townsfolk2.text: I fear the Ogres will take every last sack of grain! Will we have anything left for winter?
